title: Add Slack List items with AI, with the right fields
h1: put a new row in the slack list you chose
description: Turn a specific request into a Slack List row with a bot. Give the list link and say what goes in each column, or create a subtask under an existing item.
keyword: slack add list item with ai
answer: **rescue the repair request before channel scroll buries it.** a bot adds a slack list item with starting values, copies an existing row or creates a subtask. give the list link and columns to fill. ask for a row preview before creation: this counts as a write, so the sending setting won't pause it for you.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

og_line: one request, placed in its list.
what:
**a list row keeps a request out of channel scroll.** paste the list link and say what belongs in each column. the bot creates the row with those starting values. this action doesn't post a channel message.

for a subtask, name its parent row. for a copy, name the original and the values to replace. the connection handles slack's rich text for ordinary text values.
uses: **capture the repair request.** add the facilities problem and the location you gave.
**split a packing job.** create a subtask beneath the existing event-preparation row.
**reuse the setup structure.** copy a checklist row and replace its title for the new session.

routine.message:
every weekday at 15:25, read today's messages in the alderwick hall facilities-intake slack channel. use requests marked ready for list there.

compare them with the repairs list and skip requests already represented. show proposed rows here before adding anything. after i approve, create those rows and report which ones succeeded. stop on an uncertain match. leave unknown owners blank. never copy yesterday's requests or post a channel message.
routine.needs: slack read and write; channel and list reads plus list creation; connect an account that can edit the list
routine.output:
alderwick hall repairs preview
request: replace meeting room door sign
location: west corridor
owner: blank

row ready for review.

steps: **connect an account that can edit the list.** give this bot slack read and write.
**map one request.** paste the list link, name the columns and ask for a row preview only.
**leave gaps visible.** say which fields may stay blank and which missing details should stop the job.
**open one new row.** read its cells before scheduling daily intake.
watch: **the account needs list access.** channel membership alone doesn't promise it can edit this list.
**values must fit their columns.** dates belong in date columns. preview the mapping before creation.
**duplicates still become rows.** compare today's marked requests with existing entries before adding more.

faq.q: can it add a subtask instead of a top-level row?
faq.a: **yes, name the parent row.** the bot can attach the new entry beneath it.

faq.q: does adding a list row count as sending a slack message?
faq.a: **it counts as a write.** ask for a review in the routine itself; the sending setting does not pause list creation.

steps: describe one request and its column values
ask for a row preview without creation
confirm it, then read the saved cells

mistakes.mistake: inventing an owner to fill the row
mistakes.fix: leave ownership blank or ask. an empty cell beats assigning the wrong person.

mistakes.mistake: copying a row with old values intact
mistakes.fix: name the values to replace. a new title alone can leave yesterday's details behind.

tip.text: one request per row makes the next action clearer. put packing details beneath it as subtasks when needed.
